title: Attacker can perform DOS attack by locking user
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  An attacker can use `create_lock_for()` to create locks on behalf of other users using just 1 wei and `MAXTIME`, reaching `MAX_DELEGATES`.
